issues.body:
## Goal

Users install only Open Office Studio and can then open and save all common office files.

## Current behavior

Only DOCX, XLSX, and PPTX work directly. ODF, legacy binary formats, and PDF export require a separately installed conversion program through `OPENAEC_CONVERSIE_PROGRAMMA` (see `docs/formaten.md`).

## Expected behavior

- [ ] Investigate approach A: bundle an open-source conversion runtime (sidecar or WASM). Measure installation size, startup time, conversion time, and memory; licensing obligations; signing and notarization of bundled binaries; disable macros during conversion.
- [ ] Investigate approach B: implement importers and exporters per format (for example ODF directly to the internal model).
- [ ] Investigate approach C: combine approaches, such as native ODF/PDF support with a runtime only for legacy binary formats, potentially as an optional download.
- [ ] Record the decision and measurements in `docs/ontwerp`.
- [ ] The standard installation opens every format in `src/formaten.json` without additional installations or environment variables.
- [ ] Browser version: the same coverage, or a clearly documented limitation.

## Related

- ODF follow-up: #6.
- Per format: #31, #32, #33, #34, #35, #36; PDF: #37.
- Part of roadmap #12.
issues.title: Formats: open all supported formats without a separately installed conversion program

issues.body:
## Goal

Open less common files, or clearly explain why they cannot be opened.

## Expected behavior

- [ ] For each extension in `src/formaten.json`, record whether opening has been tested, with a sample file or an explanation of its absence.
- [ ] Priority: WPD, WPS, WRI, LWP, PAGES, NUMBERS, KEY, HWP, WK1/WK3/WK4, DBF, and SXW/SXC/SXI.
- [ ] Give unsupported variants a clear message with a suggested alternative.
- [ ] Update `docs/formaten.md`.

## Related

- Approach: #30.
- Part of roadmap #12.

issues.body:
## Goal

Add links and illustrations to worksheets.

## Expected behavior

- [ ] Insert hyperlinks to websites, files, sheets, or cells; HYPERLINK function.
- [ ] Insert, move, and resize images anchored to cells.
- [ ] Shapes and text boxes.
- [ ] Correctly render and preserve existing objects.

## Related

- Part of roadmap #12.
